primary.why: Pepsiman has no sourced modern official port or remaster. The original Japanese PlayStation disc is the only real route, with PS1 hardware or accurate PS1 emulation preserving its advergame/endless-runner timing and FMV presentation.
primary.how_to_play: Use an original Japanese disc on PlayStation hardware or DuckStation/Mednafen with a legally owned disc image. Record region, controller, emulator/core, internal resolution, FMV playback, memory-card state, stage/segment, and whether speedrun/cult-community context was excluded.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No competing official edition/remaster is sourced; the main issue is original-disc access and accurate PS1 playback.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced modern rerelease. Avoid treating fan videos/speedrun context as an official release route.
